title: Senior Professional, Solutions Architect
description:
The Solution Architect is responsible for designing technology solutions within the Solution Delivery function across a global engineering and professional services organisation of over 75,000 employees, as a member of a global team of Solution Architects.

The role designs solutions primarily in support of corporate functions, while also supporting engineering and digital fee-earning business areas where required. Solutions may range from SaaS platforms requiring integration with enterprise systems through to bespoke applications developed to meet WSP's specific business requirements.

The role converts business needs into secure, scalable, supportable and cost-effective designs, predominantly on Microsoft Azure, that align with Enterprise Architecture and WSP policy and are approved through the Cloud Design Review Board (CDRB).

  

**Requirements & Solution Design**

* **Requirements Translation** – Convert business needs into clear technical specifications, working with business stakeholders and analysts to understand requirements and constraints.
* **End-to-End Solution Design** – Create holistic designs across applications, data, integration, cloud, infrastructure, security and supporting IT services.
* **Scalability & Performance** – Design systems for growth, resilience and reliability.
* **Integration & Data Movement** – Define API, integration, data movement and orchestration patterns across applications, SaaS platforms and enterprise systems.
* **Operational Design** – Define monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, support handover to service management, and plan for lifecycle and decommissioning.

**Technology Selection & Cost Efficiency**

* **Technology Selection** – Recommend appropriate tools, platforms and services, evaluating SaaS, platform and bespoke options. Where appropriate, facilitate the commissioning of technology resources.
* **Proof of Concept** – Develop or direct proof-of-concepts to validate architecture, technology choices and solution feasibility before committing to delivery.
* **Cost Efficiency** – Optimise solutions for performance and cost, promoting reuse of existing platforms and patterns.
* **Estimating & Costing** – Produce build and running-cost estimates for solution options to support business cases and investment approval.

**Governance, Risk & Quality**

* **Architectural Alignment** – Align solutions with Enterprise Architecture and WSP Infrastructure and InfoSec policy. Take designs through CDRB approval, meeting the requirements of the cloud, security and workplace (Entra ID / directory services) teams, and keep delivery aligned with the approved design.
* **Risk Mitigation** – Apply Zero Trust and secure-by-design principles, and identify and design around technical risks, dependencies and architectural debt.
* **Data Protection** – Ensure designs meet GDPR and regional data protection and residency requirements, supporting data protection impact assessments where required.
* **Quality Assurance** – Ensure solutions are maintainable, secure and compliant through design and conformance reviews.
* **Application Modernisation** – Guide the transition of legacy applications to supported, cloud-native and maintainable architectures.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* **Cross-Team Coordination** – Liaise between business analysts, developers, testers, infrastructure, security, data, integration and service management teams to ensure designs are understood and delivered as intended.
* **Documentation & Communication** – Produce clear, consistent architecture documentation and communicate technical concepts, options and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Standards & Patterns** – Support the Lead Solution Architect by contributing to Solution Architecture standards, reusable patterns and reference designs.
* **AI-Assisted Delivery** – Use AI tools to accelerate documentation, design options and proof-of-concepts, with appropriate architect review.

**Core Technical Skillset**

* **Architecture:** cloud-native, microservices, API and integration architecture, full-stack application layers (frontend, APIs, backend services, data), clean architecture, SaaS integration, application modernisation.
* **Azure:** Logic Apps, APIM, Functions, Service Bus, Data Factory, App Service/Container Apps, Azure SQL, Key Vault.
* **Identity & Security:** Entra ID, managed identity, OAuth/on-behalf-of, RBAC, Zero Trust, secrets management.
* **Engineering & DevOps:** .NET, REST API design, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/Terraform), Dev/Test/Prod environment strategy and promotion.
* **AI:** GitHub Copilot, responsible AI-assisted development and emerging technologies.

  

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

**Essential**

* 8+ years' experience in solution architecture or a senior technical design role.
* Proven end-to-end design of SaaS and bespoke solutions, from requirements to delivery.
* Strong Azure and .NET knowledge, including integration, security and modern delivery practices.
* Experience taking designs through formal design review boards.
* Ability to evaluate technologies on fit, cost, risk and scalability.
* Strong documentation, communication and stakeholder skills.

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the Unified Data Delivery Platform, the new platform being built to deliver all of Gracenote's Video data to clients and partners
* Own the portfolio of Video metadata delivery solutions that clients rely on today
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of two product managers in India
* Collaborate with clients and partners to understand the business problems of delivering and ingesting TV entertainment data into their backend solutions, and turn that insight into a clear product vision and roadmap
* Travel to the US and Europe a couple of times per year to meet clients and partners face to face, building the direct market understanding that informs the product vision
* Partner with engineering teams, external partners, and internal stakeholders to prioritize and deliver the roadmap
* Work closely with UX and engineering to deliver the configuration and analytics tools that make the platform successful for clients and internal teams
* Serve as the senior product escalation point when delivery issues arise, leading root cause analysis and driving resolution with engineering and client-facing teams
* Work with senior management to identify opportunities and risks, including new products, infrastructure strategy, and quality initiatives
* Closely manage the cloud infrastructure and costs associated with the data platform

* Experience building and operating high-scale data or distribution systems
* Hands-on experience with XML, JSON, and REST APIs. Actively uses LLMs to write Python scripts and SQL to answer product questions independently

* Willingness to flex working hours for regular overlap with US and European clients and stakeholders
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

* Bachelor's degree or higher. Computer Science or Engineering major is preferable

* Development experience with Gracenote, TMS, ROVI, or other structured entertainment databases

description:
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

**Purpose and Scope:**

* We are seeking an experienced Research Data Modeler to design, build, deploy, and maintain reliable, scalable, and governed research data pipelines and reusable data products supporting Research & Discovery, translational science, analytics, reporting, AI, and scientific decision-making.
* Working with Research scientists, Data Product Owners, Domain Data Architects, Data Governance Specialists, Data Scientists, and Platform Engineers, this role transforms raw scientific and laboratory data into trusted assets on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform across Astellas medallion architecture.
* The successful candidate will combine strong data modeling expertise with knowledge of pharmaceutical Research and Discovery data and an ability to facilitate alignment among scientific, business, governance, architecture, engineering, and AI stakeholders.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Design and maintain conceptual, canonical, logical, semantic, and physical data models for Research and Discovery data products.
* Translate scientific, experimental, and business requirements into reusable enterprise information models.
* Define core Research entities, attributes, identifiers, relationships, hierarchies, experimental context, events, and scientific business rules.
* Establish canonical representations across laboratories, research sites, source systems, external providers, and data products.
* Model structured, semi-structured, unstructured, and multimodal scientific data while preserving provenance and experimental context.
* Ensure models support scientific analysis, advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, knowledge graphs, and application integration.
* Apply relational, dimensional, graph, document, event-based, and other modeling techniques based on scientific and technical requirements.
* Maintain clear separation between source-aligned models, canonical domain models, governed data products, and consumption-specific assets.
* Work with the Domain Data Architect and Data Product Owners to translate the approved domain data product roadmap into actionable modeling deliverables.
* Define the information models needed to support planned data products, use cases, releases, and AI capabilities.
* Identify common entities and reusable modeling components that can serve multiple data products.
* Sequence modeling work based on product priorities, source dependencies, governance readiness, and engineering needs.
* Provide modeling estimates, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and decisions required for product delivery.
* Participate in backlog refinement and help define modeling stories, acceptance criteria, and definitions of done.
* Ensure delivered models remain aligned with the target-state domain architecture and product portfolio.
* Develop canonical models that harmonize semantically equivalent data across multiple source systems.
* Define authoritative entity structures, relationships, cardinality, keys, reference data, and lifecycle states.
* Establish standards for enterprise identifiers and cross-system identity resolution.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Management, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Five or more years of experience in data modeling, information architecture, data architecture, analytics engineering, or enterprise data management.
* Experience working with research data, research data platforms, and pipelines
* Demonstrated experience developing conceptual, logical, canonical, dimensional, semantic, and physical data models.
* Strong knowledge of relational modeling, normalization, dimensional modeling, entity-relationship modeling, and metadata management.
* Experience translating complex scientific requirements into reusable information models.
* Experience defining entities, relationships, identifiers, hierarchies, reference data, and business rules.
* Experience collaborating with architects, Product Owners, engineers, Governance Specialists, and business subject matter experts.
* Strong facilitation, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences Research and Discovery.
* Knowledge of one or more Research areas such as discovery biology, target biology, medicinal chemistry, compound and assay data, translational science, or preclinical research.
* Experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, or comparable cloud data and metadata platforms.
* Experience with data modeling tools such as ER/Studio, erwin, SAP PowerDesigner, Hackolade, or comparable solutions.
* Experience with scientific ontologies, knowledge graphs, controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, or semantic modeling.
* Familiarity with Genie, natural-language analytics, semantic layers, or AI agent enablement.
* Familiarity with FAIR data principles and scientific data provenance.

Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility Guidelines. Global collaboration and limited travel may be required.

description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

### **About JumpCloud®**

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

### **About the Role**

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to join JumpCloud's Cloud Platform organization, with a focus on observability and FinOps.

You'll own the questions that matter most as we scale toward 99.99% availability: can we see what's happening across the platform, how fast do we recover when something breaks, can we survive a regional outage, and are we spending enough to run it all? This is a hands-on staff role. You'll set the technical direction for observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and cloud cost, write the code and AI-driven automation that make it real, and work closely with engineering, customer support, finance, and leadership.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

**Observability**

* Set the technical direction for observability across JumpCloud's cloud platform: metrics, logs, traces, and events, on AWS and GCP.
* Build and run our observability stack (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), including standard instrumentation libraries and collectors that teams adopt by default.
* Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with service owners, and build the dashboards and burn-rate alerts that hold us to a 99.99% SLA.
* Cut alert noise. Make sure every page is actionable, routed to the right owner, and backed by a runbook.
* Shorten detection and recovery times (MTTD and MTTR) by improving tracing, correlation, and incident tooling.
* Manage observability cost itself: cardinality, log volume, sampling, and retention, so visibility grows without the bill growing with it.

**FinOps**

* Own cloud cost visibility: tagging standards, cost allocation by team and service, and showback reports that engineers actually read.
* Find and deliver savings through right-sizing, autoscaling, spot capacity, storage tiering, idle-resource cleanup, and data-transfer reduction.
* Shape our commitment strategy (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, committed-use discounts) with finance, based on real usage data.
* Build automation and guardrails, such as budget alerts, anomaly detection, and policy-as-code checks, that catch waste before it ships.
* Define unit economics, like cost per customer or per device, and make cost a normal input to design reviews.
* Partner with finance on forecasting and budgeting, and explain cloud spend clearly to leadership.

**Incident Management and AI-Driven Automation**

* Own the incident management process end to end: severity levels, on-call rotations, escalation paths, communication, and the tooling behind them.
* Lead major incidents as incident commander or senior escalation point, and keep customers and leadership informed.
* Run root cause analysis (RCA) for significant incidents, and drive the follow-up actions to completion so issues don't repeat.
* Build AI agents that correlate alerts, logs, traces, and recent changes to find the likely root cause automatically.
* Build self-healing automation and AI agents that detect and fix known issues before they escalate or reach customers, with safe guardrails and human approval where it matters.
* Measure and improve incident health over time: MTTD, MTTR, repeat incidents, and on-call load.

**Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery**

* Own JumpCloud's business continuity (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategy for the cloud platform.
* Define RTO and RPO targets with product and leadership, and design the architecture to meet them.
* Design and build the DR site and recovery environment across AWS and GCP, including data replication, backups, failover, and failback.
* Plan and run regular DR tests and failover drills, document the results, and close the gaps they reveal.
* Keep DR runbooks, recovery automation, and BCP plans current, and support audit and customer requests for evidence.

**Across Everything**

* Write production-quality Go or Python for tooling, exporters, data pipelines, and automation.
* Work closely with customer support teams: turn support tickets and escalations into monitoring, alerts, and fixes, and give support the visibility they need to answer customers quickly.
* Partner with product engineering teams on reliability, recoverability, and cost-aware design.
* Write design docs, review architecture across engineering, and mentor engineers on observability and cost-aware design.

### **We're Looking For**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years in platform, SRE, or infrastructure roles running 24/7 SaaS systems at scale.
* **Observability depth:** You've designed and run observability at scale with Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. You know how to instrument services, set meaningful SLOs, and build alerts people trust.
* **FinOps track record:** You've cut cloud spend in a measurable way, and you can show the numbers. You're comfortable with AWS Cost Explorer, CUR, Kubecost, or similar tools, and with commitment planning.
* **Strong coding skills:** You've built production tooling and automation in Go or Python, not just dashboards and scripts.
* **AWS, GCP, and Terraform:** strong hands-on production experience with both AWS and GCP, and with Terraform for infrastructure as code. Production Kubernetes experience is expected.
* **Incident management:** You've owned on-call and incident processes, led major incidents, and run RCAs that led to lasting fixes.
* **AI and automation:** You've built automation for incident response or remediation, and you have hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-based tools for root cause analysis or auto-remediation.
* **BCP and DR:** You've designed and tested disaster recovery for production SaaS systems, including RTO and RPO targets, DR sites, replication, and failover drills.
* **Engineering and customer focus:** You have a software engineering background and have worked closely with customer support teams to resolve issues and reduce customer impact.
* **Staff-level influence:** You've driven change across multiple teams without direct authority, and you can get engineers to care about both reliability and cost.
* Clear communication with engineers, finance, and leadership. You can turn usage and cost data into a simple story and a clear decision.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* A strong team player who lives our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* FinOps Certified Practitioner, or hands-on experience applying the FinOps Framework.
* Experience with cost tools such as CloudHealth, Vantage, Cloudability, or AWS Compute Optimizer.
* Experience building cost and usage data pipelines (AWS CUR, BigQuery billing export, Athena) and reporting on top of them.
* Experience running observability in-house at scale (Prometheus/Thanos/Mimir, Loki, Tempo) and weighing that against SaaS vendors.
* Experience with eBPF-based monitoring, continuous profiling, or real user monitoring.
* Experience negotiating or managing vendor contracts for observability or cloud spend.

Established in 2004, **OLIVER** is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of **The Brandtech Group**, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our **AI solutions** enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

**Role:** Brand Consultant - Skincare

**Location:** Mumbai, India

  

**About the role:**

The brand is one of HUL's most distinctive purpose-led beauty brands. It's built on the belief that small acts of love, for yourself and the planet, can make a big difference. The brand already has a strong foothold with India's Gen Z in haircare. Now it's writing its skincare chapter from a blank page.

The Opportunity We're building Skincare from zero to one. Strategy is only half the job. The other half is getting it done: briefs that land, timelines that hold, packs that print right and launches that go live on time and in full.

We're looking for someone who sits at the center of that execution. You'll work closely with the Brand Manager to turn ideas into products on shelf and content in feeds. You'll get hands-on exposure to every part of a launch, and you'll learn faster than in almost any other role in the building.

  

**What you will be doing:**

* Launch execution and project management: Own the launch tracker across the 3Ps of Brand Development: Product, Packaging and Proposition. Run cross-functional cadences with R&D, Supply Chain, CMI, Finance, Brand Building and e-commerce teams. Flag risks early, chase closures and keep every milestone on track for OTIF delivery.
* Consumer intimacy and trend scouting: Interest to build deep understanding of consumer needs, keep a live pulse on skincare culture: ingredients, formats, D2C launches, creators, Reddit and Instagram conversations, and e-commerce reviews. Turn what you find into short, sharp inputs/ insights for strategy and mix development to help build the brand innovation funnel.
* Product and Packaging: Translate trends / consumer needs to innovation product briefs with relevant claims. Drive packaging artwork development and approvals from brief to print-ready. Make sure claims, regulatory copy, barcodes and design files are accurate. Coordinate with design agencies and packaging development, and catch the error before it reaches the line.
* Craft communication: Support agency briefs for crafting communication, content, PDP and listing content for all launches. Track campaign and platform performance (Meta, quick commerce, marketplaces) and suggest what to change as we go along the journey.
* Operational rigour: Manage POs, budgets, agency billing and documentation. Keep the brand machine running cleanly in the background.

  

**What you need to be great in this role:**

* Experience: 3–4 years in brand marketing, e-commerce or digital marketing, beauty or D2C startups, or agency account management. FMCG or beauty exposure is a strong plus.
* Love for beauty and trends: You're a genuine skincare enthusiast. You know what's trending on beauty Instagram, you have opinions on niacinamide and on new D2C launches, and you notice when a brand gets Gen Z right or wrong.
* Bias for action: You chase things down and close loops without needing a reminder.
* Intent to learn: You're curious, open to feedback and keen to grow into a Brand Manager. You ask "why" as often as "when."
* Attention to detail: Typos, wrong SKU codes and mismatched claims bother you. You check twice and send once.
* Appreciation for operations: You understand that great brands are built in trackers, artwork rounds and supply calls as much as in strategy decks, and you enjoy that work.
Tools and skills: Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills. Ability to lead cross-functional teams and working in harmony is a huge plus

**What You'll Gain**

* Front-row exposure to building a new brand from scratch: strategy, mix, launch and in-market learning.
* Close mentorship and a fast-track learning curve.
* Ownership of real deliverables with visible business impact from Year 1.

**In the interview, we'll look for:**

* Evidence that you've delivered complex work end to end
* A real point of view on beauty trends and brands
* Examples of catching what others missed
* Learning agility
* Passion for and inquisitive about AI and new technologies
* Understanding and knowledge of AI tools is beneficial, but ability to learn and digest benefits and features of AI tools is critical

* 6+ years of experience as a BIM Engineer, BIM Technician, or Structural Revit Technician
* Strong expertise in Autodesk Revit, including structural modelling and drawing production.
* Ability to interpret structural drawings, engineering mark-ups, and technical documentation.
* Excellent attention to detail and effective communication with engineers and BIM teams
* Desirable experience in UK rail projects, model coordination, clash detection, and common data environments (CDE).
* Interest in Dynamo, Revit API, automation, and AI-driven solutions to improve project delivery.
